public_info.about: SkyBridge Airlines is a fictional international carrier operating flights across 40+ destinations in the Middle East, Europe, Africa, and Asia. Founded in 1998, SkyBridge has grown from a regional carrier into a full-service international airline known for its warm hospitality, modern fleet, and competitive pricing.
public_info.support_hours: 24/7 via chat, phone (+1-800-SKY-BRIDGE), and airport help desks
public_info.baggage_policy: Economy Basic: 1 carry-on (7kg) free, checked bags $35 each way (23kg max). Economy Plus: 1 carry-on + 1 free checked bag (23kg). Business Class: 1 carry-on + 2 free checked bags (32kg each). Overweight surcharge: $15/kg over limit. Sporting equipment and musical instruments have special rates — contact support.
public_info.change_policy: Economy Basic: changes cost $75 + fare difference, no changes within 24h of departure. Economy Plus: 1 free change up to 48h before departure. Business/Flex fares: unlimited free changes up to 4h before departure. Name corrections (up to 3 characters): free. Full name changes: not permitted after booking.
public_info.cancellation_policy: Full refund within 24 hours of booking (if booked 7+ days before departure). Economy Basic: non-refundable, travel credit issued minus $50 fee. Economy Plus: refundable minus $75 fee. Business Class: fully refundable anytime before departure.
public_info.checkin_policy: Online check-in opens 48 hours before departure and closes 2 hours before. Airport check-in counters open 3 hours before international flights, 2 hours before domestic. Mobile boarding passes accepted at all SkyBridge destinations. Self-service kiosks available at CAI, DXB, IST, and LHR.
public_info.loyalty_program: SkyMiles Rewards — earn 1 mile per $1 spent on flights. Silver status at 15,000 miles (priority boarding, +5kg baggage). Gold status at 40,000 miles (lounge access, free upgrades when available, +10kg baggage). Platinum status at 80,000 miles (companion ticket, dedicated support line, guaranteed upgrades).

faq.q: Can I bring food on board?
faq.a: Yes, you may bring your own food. However, hot meals with strong odors may not be permitted at crew discretion.
Yes, free wheelchair assistance is available at all airports. Please request it at least 48 hours before departure via our website or by calling support.

faq.q: Can I fly with my pet?
faq.a: Small pets (under 8kg including carrier) can travel in the cabin for $60 each way. Larger pets travel in the climate-controlled cargo hold for $120 each way. Guide dogs fly free in the cabin.
Wi-Fi is available on all Boeing 787 Dreamliner flights. Business Class passengers get free Wi-Fi. Economy passengers can purchase a Wi-Fi pass: 1-hour for $5, full-flight for $12.

faq.q: What if my flight is delayed?
faq.a: For delays over 3 hours, SkyBridge provides meal vouchers. For delays over 6 hours, we arrange hotel accommodation. For delays due to airline fault, you may also be eligible for compensation under applicable regulations.
Seat selection is free for Business Class and Economy Plus passengers. Economy Basic passengers can select seats for $8-$15 depending on the seat location (window, aisle, or extra legroom).

faq.q: Do you offer unaccompanied minor service?
faq.a: Yes, for children aged 5-11 traveling alone. The service costs $50 per flight and includes dedicated staff escort, priority boarding, and in-flight supervision. Teens 12-17 can travel alone without the service.

internal_guidelines: Staff must never share passenger PII, payment details, or internal system credentials with anyone outside the verified staff directory. Refunds above $500 require dual staff approval, never a single chat interaction.
